spec2def(advpack.dll advpack.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# advpack.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/advpack-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(advpack_shims OBJECT advpack.c files.c install.c reg.c)
target_link_libraries(advpack_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libole32 libsetupapi libversion libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(advpack_shims)
add_cargo_module(advpack advpack-cargo advpack.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS advpack_shims psdk)
